custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test and set it inactive.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Inactive tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425605-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425605-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on with nothing ticked.

Step 3:

  • The Activate button is shown but dimmed (disabled), and hovering it shows "Tick the parts to activate".

Step 4:

  • Nothing opens: no "Activate parts?" confirmation appears.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 6:

  • With 1 row ticked the button is bright blue (enabled) and no hover text appears.

Step 7:

  • Bulk mode ends and part A is still on the Inactive tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-N1: “With nothing ticked, the Activate button is visible but disabled.”
  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Activate hovered with nothing ticked | "Tick the parts to activate" | Tooltip on the disabled button”
